transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... they brought me in. I guess it was because of the fair. I was giving a talk, and... I ended up climbing onto the tractor. I just kept jerking the controls around. I was trying to show the crowd the new pattern, you know? But... I couldn't stop. Even with folks yelling at me to get down, I just couldn't make myself stop doing it. So... here I am.
Did you feel like you had to climb onto the tractor and jerk the controls around, like you couldn't help yourself?

Yeah... like I just said. I guess I couldn't help it. I had to get up there during the talk and show them the pattern with the controls. I heard everyone yelling at me to get down, but... I just couldn't make myself stop doing it.
Did you feel anxious before you climbed onto the tractor?
No. I wasn't anxious. I was just... giving my talk.
Were you thinking about the pattern with the controls before you climbed onto the tractor?
I don't rightly know. I wasn't really thinking on it beforehand... it just sort of happened.
Did you feel like you absolutely had to show them the pattern with the controls?
I suppose so. I just... I had to show the crowd that new pattern. That's why they brought me in here, I guess. Because I kept jerking the controls and... wouldn't stop.
Did you have any thoughts about the pattern with the controls repeating in your mind before you climbed onto the tractor?
No. I don't remember thinking about it before. It wasn't... repeating or nothing.
Has this kind of behavior, where you feel like you have to do something and can't stop, happened to you before and caused problems in your daily life or relationships?

Well... yeah, I suppose it has caused some trouble. My wife and the hands... they've had to take over a lot of the decisions I used to handle. Lenders, running the equipment, just the daily operations... they don't think it's safe with me in charge right now. And after that thing at the fair... well, people are starting to wonder if I can even keep running the farm at all.
Do you often feel like you have to perform certain actions or rituals over and over?
No, not really. I don't... I don't do rituals or nothing like that.
Did you feel like climbing onto the tractor and jerking the controls was something you had to do to prevent something bad from happening?
No... I wasn't thinking about nothing bad happening. I just... I just did it. That's all.
Did you have any thoughts or images that kept repeating in your mind before or during the incident at the fair?
No... I didn't have nothing like that. No pictures or... thoughts repeating on me. I just... I don't really know what was in my head, to be honest. It just wasn't like that.
Did you feel like you had to do it exactly a certain way when you were jerking the controls around on the tractor?
No, I... I didn't care how it was done. I just pulled 'em.
Did you feel like you had to be in control of the situation when you climbed onto the tractor?
No... I wasn't thinking about being in control. I just did it. That's all.
Did you feel like something very bad would happen if you didn't climb onto the tractor and jerk the controls around?
No... I didn't think about anything bad happening. I wasn't really thinking about much of anything at all. I just did it.
Did you feel relieved or a sense of satisfaction after jerking the controls around on the tractor?
No... not really. I didn't feel much of anything. Just... did it.
Did you feel anxious after you finally stopped jerking the controls around on the tractor?
No... I wasn't anxious. I just... stopped. Walked away. That's it.
Did you feel like jerking the controls around on the tractor was a way to get rid of a thought or idea that was bothering you?
No. There wasn't any thought like that. I didn't have anything bothering me. I just... I don't know why you keep asking about it. I just grabbed them, and then I was done.
Did you feel like you had to make the pattern with the controls perfect when you were jerking them around on the tractor?
No... there wasn't any pattern. I just moved them around. It had nothing to do with making it perfect. I just... I already told you, I just did it and then I was done.
Do you think that what happened at the fair was related to any thoughts that you've been having lately?
No... I don't think so. I don't really know what you're getting at with all this. It was just... things just happen sometimes. It didn't have anything to do with my thoughts.
Did you feel an overwhelming urge to climb onto the tractor and jerk the controls around?

I don't know about an urge. I was just... I was giving my talk at the fair, and I got up on the tractor. I was just trying to show them the new pattern. I kept moving the controls to show the crowd, and... I couldn't stop. People were yelling at me, but I just couldn't make myself stop doing it. That's why they brought me in here.
Have you ever felt like you had to repeat a specific behavior or action over and over again?
No, I... I don't think so. I just do what needs doing around the farm. Never really felt like I had to keep doing something over and over.
